portrait_decisions.visual_review: Viewed the 1991 source, held v1 and corrected v2. The v2 preserves a lateral forehead birthmark arc, substantial downward lobe and separated flecks on his anatomical right/viewer-left, closer to the source than the narrow v1 patch. Rounded face, gray receding hair, no glasses and serious expression retain identity. Full-body charcoal pinstripe suit/burgundy tie, both hands and shoes visible. Color and standing body are artistic; mark shape is stylized rather than a photographic tracing.
